package.name: mower_localization
package.description: Localization for the Airseekers Tron mower (ROS 2 Jazzy). Ships the robot_localization parameter sets that fuse /odom, /imu/data and the navsat_transform_node output of /fix into the REP-105 frame tree (map -> odom -> base_link, world_frame odom), and gps_gate, which republishes /fix only when NavSatFix.status.status >= STATUS_FIX and the fix's covariance is inside the configured thresholds. The ekf_node owns the odom -> base_link transform; map -> odom stays with the localization back-end (MowgliNext Invariant 2: drivers publish no TF).
